name: relaywise
description: relay — a terminal coding agent that sends every request to the right agent, model and effort (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes), in isolated sandboxes
author: Sauhard Gupta

scripts.build:
esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --jsx=automatic --minify-syntax --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=dist/relay.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --alias:react-devtools-core=./src/stubs/devtools.js
